About this Event

TICKETS: 🎟️
Click for tickets via VenuePilot.FIKR IS BACK!
Get ready for a one-of-a-kind musical journey as Seattle's very own FIKR brings their unique Hindie Rock sound to Central Saloon 🔥
This Bollywood rock band infuses modern indie rock with the vibrant rhythms and melodies of South Asia, creating an unforgettable cross-cultural experience. Whether you're a fan of indie rock, Bollywood, or both, FIKR's powerful fusion of Western and Eastern influences is sure to resonate with all music lovers. 🙌
#FIKRMATKAR

Event Details
Join us for an electrifying night at one of Seattle's most iconic venues, where history meets the future of music. Located in the heart of Pioneer Square, The Central Saloon has hosted legends like Nirvana and Soundgarden—now it's time to experience something entirely new.
Come early, stay late, and immerse yourself in the rhythm of FIKR: A Hindie Rock Experience!
